dish: Smoked brisket, pulled pork, rib tips — Southern-style 'cue
w: Pullman smokehouse of Dominique Leach, 2023 'Master of 'Cue' on Food Network's BBQ Brawl — one of the city's best barbecue spots.

dish: Tacos al pastor carved off a live-fire trompo ($1 Mondays)
w: Little Village's unlikely al pastor champion — a Chinese-Thai takeout counter whose trompo makes some of the best al pastor in Chicago.

dish: Steak tacos on fresh house tortillas, rice and beans, cafeteria line
w: The 1950 tortilla maker's cafeteria on 26th Street — fresh tortillas off the line and one of Little Village's best Mexican restaurants.

dish: Cafeteria-line fried chicken, meatloaf, candied yams, peach cobbler
w: Austin's soul-food cafeteria (1997) of Mississippi-born MacArthur Alexander — a West Side institution whose regulars included Barack Obama.

dish: Dipped Italian beef with peppery jus, then homemade lemon Italian ice
w: University Village corner stand (since 1929) — the Infatuation calls its jus the best in Chicago; cash-only ice counter next door.

dish: Craft beer and cocktails at a bowling-lane bar top
w: Pilsen's Green-Restaurant-certified bar and cultural space — solar panels, salvaged fittings, a bar made from a bowling lane.
